description: Synthetic closed-shape vectors only. Public SPKI copied from existing support/restart vectors; the synthetic support profile lists all three known purposes and establishes no genuine trust. No private key, credential, PHI/PII or live deployment setting. Runtime-only vectors deliberately pass the shape; their listed checks remain the runtime suite responsibility.

runtime_only.name: Same kid across pins
runtime_only.required_runtime_check: Runtime rejects duplicate kid even when pins are distinct objects.

runtime_only.name: Invalid public SPKI binary
runtime_only.required_runtime_check: Runtime RSA3072/e65537/SHA256 import must reject invalid DER.

runtime_only.name: Expired public pin
runtime_only.required_runtime_check: Runtime requires a currently usable selected pin and valid key window.

runtime_only.name: Bundle hash policy mismatch
runtime_only.required_runtime_check: Runtime compares the exact configured canonical policy hash and current authority row.

runtime_only.name: Bundle import order
runtime_only.required_runtime_check: Runtime requires issued_at < import_expires_at and all configured lifetime caps.

runtime_only.name: ACK before issuance
runtime_only.required_runtime_check: Runtime rejects applied_at before bundle issued_at despite its valid integer shape.
